user.title: RAPT Batch Library
user.description: Tracks fermentation batches and keeps their data outside the Home Assistant recorder. Choose how the sidebar panel appears; you can change this later under Configure. After setup, use 'Start new batch' on the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: RAPT Batches is already set up.

user.title: New batch
user.description: Name the batch and choose the RAPT Pill that is in the fermenter.

entities.title: Pill sensors
entities.description: Sensors were detected from the Pill. Correct them if needed. Only gravity is required.

details.title: How is this batch starting?
details.description: Pick one. 'Starting now' prefills the Pill's current gravity and the current time. 'Already underway' lets you enter the real OG and start time.

reconfigure.title: Manage batch
reconfigure.description: What would you like to do?

details_now.title: Starting now
details_now.description: Prefilled with the Pill's current gravity and the current time. Adjust them if needed.

details_past.title: Already underway
details_past.description: Enter the original gravity and when fermentation started. History is backfilled from Home Assistant as far back as it still exists.

finish.title: Finish batch
finish.description: Recording stops and the ABV is locked in. Leave final gravity empty to use the latest reading.

reopen.title: Reopen batch
reopen.description: Recording resumes, and readings since the batch finished are filled in from Home Assistant history. Select Submit to continue.

archive.title: Archive batch
archive.description: The batch leaves this page but stays in the library panel, where you can unarchive it. Select Submit to continue.

error.name_exists: A batch with this name already exists.
error.invalid_start: That start time could not be read.

abort.archived: Batch archived. Find it in the library panel in the sidebar.
abort.archive_failed: Only finished batches can be archived.

stop_batch.name: Stop batch
stop_batch.description: Finish an active batch and stop recording.

batch_name.name: Batch name
batch_name.description: Name of the active batch to finish.

final_gravity.name: Final gravity
final_gravity.description: Final gravity. Leave empty to use the latest reading.
